shots.prompt: Night, the old house roof, a small attic window glowing silver
lines: NARRATOR
Five nights gone. Two left. And Lumen's trail led upward, to the attic.

shots.prompt: Mira and Theo climb narrow creaky attic stairs at night, the brass lantern glowing silver, dust floating
Mira in a dusty attic looking at silver dust on the floor
lines: MIRA
Lumen came up here. Look, silver dust on every step.

shots.prompt: Theo in the dark attic holding a flashlight, nervous
lines: THEO
Great. A dark attic. My favourite place. Said nobody, ever.

shots.prompt: An old dusty star map pinned on the attic wall, its stars lighting up silver one by one
Mira studies the glowing map
lines: MIRA
It's a map of the sky. But the stars are moving.

shots.prompt: A ribbon of silver light swirls across the star map, connecting the stars into a glowing path
Theo points at the map
lines: THEO
Those stars make a path. Straight down to the Archive.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the corner of the old star map, a faded handwritten letter E and an old date in ink
Mira reads the corner of the map, surprised
lines: MIRA
There's a name here. Elias. He drew this map.

shots.prompt: The vast underground archive of glowing glass jars, warm amber light
Mira in the archive, holding the lantern
lines: MIRA
Elias, you made the star map. Why didn't you tell me?

shots.prompt: Elias holding a candle, thoughtful
lines: ELIAS
Because the map shows where every lost dream sleeps. Even mine.

shots.prompt: Elias remembering, sad smile
lines: ELIAS
Long ago, I was a keeper with a friend. We guarded these stars together.

shots.prompt: A golden dreamy memory: two young archivists in old robes walk among glowing jars holding lanterns, seen from behind
Theo realizing something
lines: THEO
Wait. Your friend. Is he... the Shadow?

shots.prompt: Elias nods slowly
lines: ELIAS
He was my friend once. He grew tired of dreams that hurt.

shots.prompt: Rows of glass jars in the archive dim and go grey one by one
lines: NARRATOR
Somewhere in the dark, the jars began to go quiet.

shots.prompt: Mira determined, lantern raised
lines: MIRA
Then we follow the map. We find Lumen before he does.

shots.prompt: The brass lantern glows brighter silver, the light pointing the way
Theo smiles bravely
lines: THEO
Two nights left. Fine. But I'm bringing more cookies.

shots.prompt: Night, a bright star over the rooftops, the lantern glowing on the windowsill
lines: NARRATOR
And on the sixth night, the Shadow made his move.
